title: Unani Ayurvedic and Homeopathic Practioners Second Amendment Ordinance 2002

sections.shortTitle: Unani Ayurvedic and Homeopathic Practioners Second Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

UNANI, AYURVEDIC AND HOMOEOPATHIC PRACTITIONERS
UNANI, AYURVEDIC
AND HOMOEOPATHIC PRACTITIONERS
(SECOND AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE LXI OF 2002
An Ordinance
further to amend the Unani, Ayurvedic and Homoeopathic Practitioners Act, 1965
[Gazette of Pakistan
Extraordinary, Part-I, 4th October, 2002]
F.No.2(1)/2002-Pub. dated
4-10-2002.---The following Ordinance promulgated by the President is hereby
published for general information:---
1. Short title and
commencement---(1) This Ordinance may be called the Unani, Ayurvedic and
Homeopathic Practitioners (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

4. Amendment of section 9, Act
II of 1965.--In the said Act, in section 9, after subsection (4), the following
new subsection shall be added, namely:--
"(5) The election or
nomination of the members of, the Council shall be held at least three months
prior to the expiry of the prescribed tenure of the Council and expenditure on
election shall be born, a by the respective council and if, at any time the
council ceases to exist on expiry of its prescribed tenure, all powers and
functions of the Council shall, till constitution of new Council or for a
period of one year, be exercised and performed by such person or authority as
may be appointed by the Federal Government in this behalf, as if such person or
authority were the Council."

Extraordinary, Part-I, 4th October, 2002]
F.No.2(1)/2002-Pub. dated
4-10-2002.---The following Ordinance promulgated by the President is hereby
published for general information:---
5. Amendment of section 16,
Act II of 1965.--In the said Act, in section 16, for subsections (1) and
(2), the following shall be substituted, namely:--
"(1) The Council shall, with
the previous approval in writing of the Federal Government, appoint a Registrar
and Controller of Examination of such terms and conditions as may be determined
by the Federal Government and may appoint a person to act in his place during
his absence on leave.
(2) An order of the Council
appointing, punishing or removing the Registrar and Controller of Examination
from office shall not take effect unless confirmed by the Federal Government in
writing."

8. Amendment of section 43,
Act II of 1965.--In the said Act, the existing section 43 shall be numbered
as subsection (1) of that section and, after subsection (1) numbered aforesaid,
the following new subsections shall be added, namely:-
"(2) The accounts of the
Council shall be maintained in such form and manner as the Auditor-General of
Pakistan may prescribe.
(3) The accounts of the Council
shall be audited by one or more auditors appointed by the Federal Government in
consultation with the Auditor-General of Pakistan."

"48. Policy
issues relating to the affairs of the Council.--In the discharge of its
function, the Council shall be guided on questions of policy by the
instructions, if any, as may be given to it, from time to time by the Federal

of policy."
